stepTitle: Describe the issue that causes this error.
stepBody: An array of the average number of aces hit per match for each player.\ntennis.column("Num. Aces") / tennis.select("Matches Played")\nTypeError: ufunc 'divide' not supported for the input types, and the inputs could not be safely coerced to any supported types according to the casting rule ''safe''
choices: The code errors because the Num. Aces column contains strings rather than integers.
The code errors because the two columns have different numbers of rows.
The code errors because it attempts to divide an array by a table. Arrays can only be divided by an integer or another array of a similar data type and of the same length.
The code errors because division of one array by another array is never allowed in Python.
The code errors because the select method returns an array of strings that cannot be divided.
